title: A2UI Template Definition
description: Schema defining a parameterized A2UI declarative template authored in YAML with a nested layout tree and synthetic ID generation.

version.description: Specification version of the template definition format. Forced to '0.1'.

id.description: Optional globally unique identifier or URI for the template.

name.description: Component tag name of the template used in layout trees and LLM prompts.

catalogs.description: Catalog identifier (URI) or list of catalog identifiers against which components are resolved.

imports.description: Optional list or mapping of dependent templates imported by global ID.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this template represents.

parameters.description: Mapping of parameter names to their explicit A2UI type definitions.

requiredParameters.description: Optional list of parameter names that are required when invoking the template.

layout.description: Root component of the nested layout tree.

components.description: Optional flattened component list for internal graph representation.

sampleData.description: Sample parameter values used for previewing and testing template inflation.

title.description: Short human-readable title of the parameter.

description.description: Detailed explanation of the parameter's purpose and usage.

default.description: Default fallback value if not specified.

values.description: Allowed string values when type is 'enum'.

items.description: Item type definition when type is 'array'. Can be an A2UI type name or nested ParameterDefinition.

anyOf.description: Whether this parameter is required when instantiating the template.
List of required property names for object types.

minimum.description: Minimum value constraint for numeric parameters.

maximum.description: Maximum value constraint for numeric parameters.

param.description: Name or dot-separated path of the template parameter to substitute.

template.description: Child template identifier when mapping an array parameter to child component instances.

default.description: Fallback value if the parameter path resolves to None.

concat.description: List of literal values and parameter references to concatenate into a string.

args.description: Mapping of placeholder keys to values or parameter references.

param.description: Parameter name holding the list/array data to iterate over.

template.description: Identifier of a named template to instantiate for each item.

item.description: Self-contained inline component layout to instantiate for each item.

as.description: Optional variable scope alias for accessing item fields in expressions.

TemplateValue.description: A literal value, parameter substitution, or expression in a template component property.

id.description: Optional explicit component ID within the template.

catalogId.description: Optional catalog ID to disambiguate if the component name exists in multiple declared catalogs.

id.description: Unique component ID within the template.

catalogId.description: Optional catalog ID to disambiguate if the component name exists in multiple declared catalogs.
